s: Beshabbat yashlim mea berakot beperot ubo v' seipim: tzarik leharbot beperot umegadim umine reach im yesh lo, kede lehashlim minyan mea berakot, ap sheshshama habberakot shel qeriat hattora vehahaptara, kemo shennitbaer besimman m"v:
Im ragil beshenat tzohorayim bechol — al yebattelenna beshabbat, ki oneg hu lo:

Veachar hashshena tzarik liqboa midrash lilmod tora larabbim, shenneemar beparashat shabbat "vayyaqhel mosheh", vedareshu chakamim lamma neemar beparasha zo "vayyaqhel" shello neemar ken bekol hattora kullah? Amar haqqadosh baruk hu lemosheh "red vaaseh li qehillot gedolot beshabbat, kede sheyyilmedu haddorot habbaim achareka lehaqhel qehillot bekol shabbat lehikkanes bebatte kenesiyyot ubebatte midrashot lilmod bahem tora larabbim", al ken tzarik liqboa midrash lehodia laam et chuqqe haelohim, velidrosh bedibre aggada lehaknis yirat shamayim bilbabam, velo kemo shennohagim akshav:

Veasur liqboa seudda beet hammidrash, ella yaqdimenna o yeacharenna, shetztzerikim hakkol labo lishmoa hadderasha, o lilmod beatzmam kesheen sham doresh karauy. Vehaddoresh laam chuqqe haelohim ulehaknis bilbabam yirat shamayim venitacher labo lebet hammidrash — lo yanniach hadderasha bishbil seudda shelishit, lepi shellimmud tora veyirat shamayim larabbim qodem lekol hammitzvot shebbattora:

Lo nittenu shabbatot veyamim tobim leyisrael ella kede laasoq bahem battora, shekkol yemot hachol hem terudim bimlaktam, veen lahem penay laasoq bah biqbiut, ubeshabbat hem penuyim mimmelaka, vikolim laasoq bah karauy. Lepikak, poalim ubaale battim sheenam oseqim battora biqbiut kol yeme hashshabua — lo yamshiku harbeh beoneg akila ushetiyya beshabbat, veday lahem beoneg qetzat, shetztzerikim laasoq battora harbeh. Abal talmide chakamim haoseqim battora biqbiut kol yeme hashshabua — yamshiku qetzat yoter beoneg akila ushetiyya, ki hem mitannegim belimmudam kol yemot hashshabua. Umikkol maqom, gam hem tzerikim laasoq battora, veenam rashshaim limshok kol hayyom beoneg akila ushetiyya veshena, shehare neemar "shabbat laHashem eloheka":
Lo yomar beshabbat libne beto "nishan hayyom kede laasot melaktenu baereb" (ayyen simman sh"z):
